meta.name: process:mailbox_reconciliation
meta.description: 231 (stage U, U2c; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28: a chain is a multi-step process): an own party's period in one case: a mailbox's new emails are downloaded and read with their attachments, the bank statements side by side, and once both are done, the reconciliation pairs them, as the workflow template of the same name was (configs/workflows.json until then). Each step runs a case of its own process, a sub-case (run_case@1), and waits until it closes; a paid run of a sub-case waits for a person's start with its cost cap.

changelog.note: 231 (U2c): the first version: three sub-case steps (the emails of a mailbox, the bank statements, then the reconciliation after both) and its tabs: Overview, History; started by hand for a party and a period, each of the first two steps with its own source.

title: From the mailbox to the reconciliation
summary: An own party's period in one case: a mailbox's emails with their attachments and the bank statements are read side by side, then reconciled.
